name: rendobar
description: Serverless media processing and generation, run on files from your own disk.
long_description:
Rendobar covers both sides of media work, and this bundle is the local server for it: an agent can take a file off your machine, run the job on Rendobar's infrastructure, and hand back a hosted URL without you touching a browser.

Deterministic processing runs raw FFmpeg commands, inspects media, composes video from a declarative timeline, compresses to a size or quality budget, and burns in subtitles. Model-backed jobs generate and edit images from a prompt or a written instruction, upscale on a diffusion restoration model, and drive the transcription and keyword highlighting behind animated captions.

The job list grows, so this description names families rather than types. Call `list_job_types` for the current set, read live from the registry on every call.

The server starts without an API key so its tools can be listed. Tool calls need a key, which you can set below or write once with `rb login` from the Rendobar CLI.

api_key.title: Rendobar API key
api_key.description: Starts with rb_. Get one at https://app.rendobar.com under Settings, API Keys. Optional here: the server also reads RENDOBAR_API_KEY or the credentials file written by `rb login`.
